mentions.name: Farmdoor
mentions.description: A job board for travellers and backpackers on working holiday visas in New Zealand. Unlike most NZ job sites that are built for employers, Farmdoor lets workers leave reviews of farms and employers so the next person knows what they're signing up for before showing up somewhere remote.
mentions.problem: Most NZ job sites are built for employers, making it hard for backpackers to find reliable work and leaving them little recourse when an employer turns out to be dodgy.
mentions.audience: Travellers and backpackers on working holiday visas in New Zealand.
